name: Metronic Global Berhad
overview: Metronic Global Berhad 今年通过子公司 MGL Development 以 RM33,240,000 收购 Melaka 的 81 个单位服务式公寓，扩大物业发展板块；同时 Metronic Engineering 以 RM9,420,000 出售 Shah Alam 的工业土地及三层半独立式厂房。公司于 2026 年 7 月被列为 Paragraph 8.03A 公司。
overview_en: Metronic Global Berhad expanded its property development segment through its subsidiary MGL Development's acquisition of 81 serviced apartment units in Melaka for RM33,240,000, while Metronic Engineering disposed of an industrial land with a three-storey semi-detached factory in Shah Alam for RM9,420,000. The company was classified as a Paragraph 8.03A company in July 2026.

segments.name: 物业发展
segments.note: 今年通过子公司收购 Melaka 的服务式公寓单位，扩大物业发展业务。
segments.note_en: This year, the subsidiary acquired serviced apartment units in Melaka, expanding the property development business.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 MGL Development 与 Sanichi Precision Mould 签订 81 份买卖协议，以 RM33,240,000 收购位于 Melaka Klebang 的 Marina Point 81 个单位服务式公寓。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary MGL Development entered into 81 sale and purchase agreements with Sanichi Precision Mould to acquire 81 units of serviced apartments at Marina Point, Klebang, Melaka, for RM33,240,000.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年出售 Shah Alam 的工业土地及厂房，并被列为 Paragraph 8.03A 公司。
segments.note_en: This year, the group disposed of an industrial land and factory in Shah Alam and was classified as a Paragraph 8.03A company.

actions.title: METRONIC - New Paragraph 8.03A Company
actions.text: 公司被列为 Paragraph 8.03A 公司。
actions.text_en: The company was classified as a Paragraph 8.03A company.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Metronic Engineering 与 Twin Hydraulics Engineering 签订买卖协议，以 RM9,420,000 出售位于 Shah Alam Bukit Jelutong 的永久工业土地及三层半独立式厂房。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Metronic Engineering entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Twin Hydraulics Engineering to dispose of a freehold industrial land with a three-storey semi-detached factory in Bukit Jelutong, Shah Alam, for RM9,420,000.
